i.norm: Tolerance for comparing floating-point results (one unit in the last place).

Verifies that {@link Gaussian.Parametric#gradient} returns the partial derivatives of the Gaussian with respect to its three parameters (norm, mean, sigma).

For a Gaussian {@code f(x) = norm * exp(-(x - mean)^2 / (2 * sigma^2))} the partial derivatives at a point {@code x} are:

  • d/d(norm) = exp(-(x - mean)^2 / (2 * sigma^2))
  • d/d(mean) = norm * exp(...) * (x - mean) / sigma^2
  • d/d(sigma) = norm * exp(...) * (x - mean)^2 / sigma^3
